raw_translation: Wani kwanan wata na astronomical snapshot, ba wani Panchang ko bikin bazara/muhurta na hukuma ba. source: An approximate astronomical snapshot, not an official Panchang or festival/muhurta calendar. It uses a linear Lahiri ayanamsa approximation and one sunrise convention. Regional calendars, ephemerides, elevation, refraction and daylight boundaries may differ. It does not determine holidays, observances, auspicious times or religious guidance. Compare results with a regional Panchang.
